rationale: Use own colour and the column's nonzero colour set. In demonstration 1, column 0 has set {1,2}, changing both colours to 8; column 2 has {2,3}, changing 3 to 9. In demonstration 2, zeros in columns containing only 1 become 3.
Column sets determine recolouring: {1,2,3} maps 0 to 8 and 2 to 7; {1,3} maps 0 to 5; {2,3} maps 2 to 0. Demonstration 1 shows the first two cases, and demonstration 3 shows the third.

Use column colour sets: {1,2} maps 2 to 9; {1,2,3} maps 1 to 0 and 0 to 2; {1,3} maps 0 to 2. Demonstration 1 shows the first two cases, while demonstration 9 shows zeros becoming 2 in columns with set {1,3}.

Use the full 3x3 neighbourhood including boundary padding. Demonstration 8 changes the top-left zero to 7 with right=0, down=2, diagonal=0; demonstration 10 changes it to 6 with right=0, down=0, diagonal=0. Other observed neighbourhoods preserve their centre.

Use full 3x3 patterns. Demonstration 2 maps the all-zero in-grid neighbourhood at the top-right corner to 4. Demonstration 5 maps a right-edge zero to 5 when its upper neighbour is 3 and its other in-grid neighbours are zero.
Column set {1,3} maps 0 to 4; {1,2,3} maps both 0 and 3 to 6; {3} maps 0 to 9. Demonstration 1 shows the first two mappings, and demonstration 3 shows zeros becoming 9 in columns containing only 3.

Use directional nearest nonzero colours. Demonstration 1 changes a zero with no colour above, 1 below, and 3 on both horizontal sides to 1. Demonstrations 2 and 5 map zeros with 3 below, 1 right, and no colour above or left to 5. Demonstration 8 maps zeros with 3 below and 2 left, with no colour above or right, to 9.

Use the full 3x3 neighbourhood. Demonstration 10 changes the right-edge zero at row 5, column 6 to 2: all six in-grid entries of its neighbourhood are zero, and the rightmost neighbourhood column is boundary padding. Other demonstrated patterns preserve their centre.
Recolour border pixels by 0→5, 1→6, 2→1, 3→9, preserving interior pixels. Demonstration 1 changes its entire top and bottom rows and side columns accordingly while retaining interior 1, 2, 3, and 0.

Use own colour plus both row and column nonzero sets. A zero with row set {1,2} and column set {2,3} becomes 4, as in demonstration 1's bottom-left pixel. A 2 with row set {1,2,3} and column set {1,2,3} becomes 3, as in demonstration 6 at row 4, column 3; with column set {1,2}, it becomes 4, as in demonstration 3.
